title: Honua Map Package (honua_map_package.v1)
description: Canonical, portable, versioned description of one Honua map. This is the single map artifact JS, the CLI, the MCP server, and Studio all read and write (honua-sdk-js#1426); `src/studio/types.ts` re-tags this shape for the `map` package family rather than declaring a Studio-only twin. The schema covers sources/layers, style, popup and label (interaction) configuration, viewport, attribution, widgets/components, dependencies, and provenance. It deliberately does NOT model lifecycle states, content-hash identity, optimistic concurrency, actor/tenant, authorization scope, or audit/correlation identifiers: those belong to the canonical honua-server composition contract and are projected into the SDK through honua-sdk-js#1397 and #1398. The one lifecycle-adjacent field present, `status`, is a pre-existing server-produced value mirrored here verbatim, not a lifecycle model minted by the SDK. This file is the source of truth for `validateMapPackage`: `scripts/generate-map-package-validator.mjs` compiles it to a zero-dependency standalone validator, and `test/runtime/map-package-schema-drift.test.ts` fails when it and the TypeScript type in `src/runtime/map-package.ts` disagree.
$comment: Unknown properties are permitted at every level. The wire format is additively forward-compatible and the runtime preserves unrecognized fields through `updatePackage`; rejecting them would make every additive server revision a client-breaking change. Drift between the known-field set here and `src/runtime/map-package.ts` is caught by the drift test instead.

mapPackageId.description: Server-assigned identifier for the package. Opaque to the SDK.

format.description: Canonical format string. The version gate: the runtime loader refuses any other value.

status.description: Server-reported composition state, mirrored verbatim from the honua-server MapPackage contract. This is NOT an SDK-minted lifecycle model; the ephemeral-preview / draft / saved-version / proposal / publication states named in honua-sdk-js#1426 are owned by the server contract and land through #1397 / #1398.

expiresAt.description: Server retention / hosting expiry timestamp. A package past this instant validates as expired.

templateId.description: Composition template the package was produced from.

themeId.description: Out-of-band theme identifier, resolved by the host when `theme` is absent.

theme.description: Inline theme body. Overrides out-of-band theme lookup.

previewArtifactId.description: Identifier of a rendered preview artifact. A preview reference only; carries no assertion that the package is persisted or published.

sourceBindings.description: Protocol-neutral source bindings. Each entry is projected into a `Dataset`/`Source` by the runtime source bridge and exposed to the style as a named source.

styleRefs.description: Style overrides layered onto `mapSpec` during composition.

mapSpec.description: MapLibre-compatible style document carrying the layers and inline sources.

initialView.description: Initial camera / extent (viewport) for the composed map.

legend.description: Legend swatches rendered by the runtime.

popupBindings.description: Popup (click-interaction) configuration, resolved into click handlers by the runtime.

labelBindings.description: Label configuration; v1 is pass-through metadata for the runtime.

boundArtifacts.description: Identifiers of workspace artifacts bound into this package.

attribution.description: Package-wide attribution notices. Per-source credit stays on the binding.

widgets.description: Renderer-neutral widgets/components declared by the package.

dependencies.description: External capabilities required to render at full fidelity. Declarative: nothing in the SDK installs or resolves these.

provenance.description: How the package was produced. Descriptive only; carries no identity or governance semantics.

sourceBinding.description: One inlined source binding. `sourceId` is the stable diff key and the name layers reference.

sourceId.description: Stable, package-unique source name. Referenced by `mapSpec.layers[].source`.

protocol.description: Wire protocol, in the server's snake_case form. Translated to the SDK's kebab-case `Protocol` union in `source-bridge.ts`.

attribution.description: Free-form attribution text for this source.

metadata.description: Out-of-band binding metadata, preserved round-trip. Never a credential store: `exportMapPackage` strips any key whose name reads as a secret.

locator.description: Protocol-specific endpoint information. Additive by design; newer server revisions add fields here without a format bump.

url.description: Service endpoint. Required in practice by `validateMapPackage`; optional in the shape so a locator addressed purely by `serviceId` still parses.

layerId.description: Layer index or id. The server's canonical type is a string; numeric forms are accepted for historical SDK compatibility and coerced before `createDataset`.

styleRef.description: A style reference carried inline on the package body. When `body` is absent the host resolves it out-of-band through `resolveStyleRef`.

styleRefBody.description: Resolved style-ref body: MapLibre layer overrides keyed by layer id. `{theme:key}` token placeholders are substituted from the active theme during composition.

styleRefLayerOverride.description: Partial layer specification applied on top of `mapSpec.layers[i]`.

themeSpec.description: Flat, name-keyed design-token map. Richer ramp/typography shapes can be added without breaking the runtime surface.

mapSpec.description: MapLibre style document. Only the structural invariants the runtime depends on are asserted here — `version`, a `sources` map, and a `layers` array. Full MapLibre validity is delegated to `@maplibre/maplibre-gl-style-spec` through `src/runtime/style-spec-validation.ts`; restating the entire style spec in this file would create a second style contract that immediately drifts from the upstream one.

sources.description: Inline MapLibre sources, keyed by source name. Names here and `sourceBindings[].sourceId` share one namespace: a layer may reference either.

initialView.description: Viewport. `bbox` and `center`/`zoom` may both be present; the runtime prefers `bbox` when it is well-formed.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] in `crs`, defaulting to CRS84.

fieldName.description: Source field to render. Optional when `template` is set.

template.description: Popup template. Defaults to neutral `key: value` rows.

text.description: Plain text; hosts escape before rendering.

sourceIds.description: Bindings this notice covers. Omitted means package-wide.

required.description: Whether the host must display this notice (licence obligation).

widget.description: A declared map component. `type` is an open string: the widget catalogue belongs to the host application, and closing it here would make every new component a breaking change to the artifact.

visible.description: Whether the widget starts visible. Defaults to true when omitted.

versionRange.description: semver range the package was authored against.

optional.description: Whether the package still renders (degraded) without it.

provenance.description: Descriptive production record. Deliberately carries no content hash, actor/tenant, authorization scope, or audit/correlation identifier — those are identity and governance concerns owned by the honua-server composition contract (honua-sdk-js#1397 / #1398).

generatedBy.description: Tool that produced the package, e.g. `honua-cli`, `@honua/mcp-server`.

derivedFrom.description: Ids of upstream artifacts this package was composed from.
